title: EGT Indicator
text: Display measurements for engine exhaust gas temperature (EGT), {Label} sets Block label location; {Connection} sets the connect to signal, {Minimum}, {Maximum} and {Scale Colors} sets the ranges of color bands. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum tick mark value 0 (default) | finite | double | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum tick mark value 1000 (default) | finite | double | scalar

params.name: Scale Colors
params.values: Ranges of color bands 0 (default) | double | scalar

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label location Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
